name: Tinker - Mech (III)
description: (Tag:tinker)(Tech) Design, modify, and build Mech tech and large piloted armors. At this level, create powerful versatile mechs rivaling Knightmares, e.g. large mechs enduring missile barrages with street-demolishing cannons and guns. Can also design mech-only weaponry/modules based on your other abilities and traits.
